plan.title: fix(lifecycle): completion PRs fail the merge gate because scope:complete now also writes PROJECT-DEFINITION

narratives.Description: fix(lifecycle): completion PRs fail the merge gate because scope:complete now also writes PROJECT-DEFINITION
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Since #6689, `scope:complete` also rewrites `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` (the open-scope list) when it moves a brief to `completed/`. That file is not in the lifecycle-only path family (`isDeliveryBriefLandPath` in `packages/core/src/scope/delivery-evidence.ts`). So a post-merge completion PR that holds only what the lifecycle verb wrote cannot pass the merge gate:

- Without a changelog fragment, `verify:changelog-unreleased` fails: "change set adds neither a CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] line nor a changelog.d/ fragment".
- With a fragment, `verify:scope-provenance` fails: the spec-drift row file and `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` are "outside membership allowlist", because the row file is admitted only when the whole change set is a completion move.

Evidence: PR #6755 (complete the P2-U0 brief after #6662). Head a8cdaf759 (no fragment): merge gate fails on `verify:changelog-unreleased`. Head 2a7e0420b (with fragment): merge gate fails on `verify:scope-provenance`. The change set is exactly the verb output: brief rename `active/` to `completed/`, `xbrief/.audit/spec-drift/<scopeId>.json`, `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`.

Completion PRs pass today only when the brief listed `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` and its row file in `file_scope` before activation (#6754, #6757). Briefs activated before #6689 do not, so about 20 OVPR briefs cannot be completed.

## Fix

1. A completion-move change set (only lifecycle briefs, changelog entry paths, the spec-drift ledger and row files, and `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`, with at least one brief under `completed/`) is lifecycle-only for both `verify:changelog-unreleased` and `verify:scope-provenance` membership.
2. `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` is admitted only under that completion-move shape. A change set that edits it together with any product file still needs a changelog entry and is still fenced by membership.
3. `swarm:finalize-cohort` stages `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` with the completed briefs when the sweep changed it, so its lifecycle commit has the same shape.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A change set of one brief rename `xbrief/active/` to `xbrief/completed/`, its spec-drift row file and `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` passes `verify:changelog-unreleased` with no new changelog entry.
- The same change set passes `verify:scope-provenance` membership with no `file_scope` entry for the row file or `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`.
- A change set that edits `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` together with a production source file still fails `verify:changelog-unreleased` without an entry, and the production file is still checked against `file_scope`.
- A change set that edits only `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`, with no brief under `completed/`, is not lifecycle-only.
- `swarm:finalize-cohort` commits `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` in its lifecycle commit when the sweep changed it.
